title.narrative: Training of Trainers of Child Rights Ambassadors Platform
Training of Trainers of Child Rights Ambassadors Platform

description.narrative: Ett kapacitetsstärkande projekt som ska sprida kunskap om barnkonventionen och lära målgruppen hur man blir förändringsaktörer bland annat genom en webbaserad utbildning.

We will create an online digital learning platform for training Trainers of Trainers – young adults including teachers and youth leaders. They gain knowledge and skills that empower them in their own lives, and as trainers of children who become Child Rights Ambassadors. The Ambassadors, children 10–17, become changemakers where they live and in schools, for equal rights, especially girls’ rights, the Global Goals and a sustainable future. Both trainers and children go on to educate and empower their peers, also demanding from duty-bearers – including leaders on local and municipal levels – on the Rights of the Child, democracy, sustainable development and every child’s right to participation in local government. In the long term this will contribute to systematic and structural change, and the fulfilment of Global Goal 16.
